title: limonium caspium var. patens
intro: Limonium caspium var. patens, commonly known as Caspian sea lavender, is a flowering plant species within the family Plumbaginaceae. The Caspian sea lavender is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Caspian sea lavender include its use as a calming agent, relieving anxiety and stress, and its ability to act as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
